text:
alex.h: Hey everyone — Alex here, started this week on infra. Trying to get GCP access for some EU projects so I can run a quick Private deployment eval. I'm seeing a 403 when I switch to the europe-west1 project. What exact roles do I need to: 1) view the project, 2) create service accounts, and 3) link the project to our EU billing account? Who should I ping to get this done quickly?
maria: welcome Alex! For GCP access please file the cloud access form (https://go/redwood/cloud-access) with the project ID + justification. For a quick unblock I can grant you roles/browser + iam.serviceAccountUser on the project temporarily. Which project ID are you trying to reach? :wave:
alex.h: thanks — project is redwood-eu-sandbox (project-id: redwood-eu-sandbox-2026). I mostly need to create a SA and push a small VM+container for testing, and I need it linked to the EU billing account.
samir: finance here — we can link the project to the EU billing acct once we have the project ID + short cost justification and cost center. Billing account name is `redwood-eu-main` (billing-id: 01A2-BC34-EE). If this is a short eval, say expected spend < $200/month and we'll apply the dev billing policy.
tia: security note — please avoid org/Owner. Minimum permissions: roles/browser (to list), roles/iam.serviceAccountUser (to act as SA), roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin (only if you must create SAs), and for compute `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` if you're creating VMs. For storage access use `roles/storage.objectAdmin` scoped to the specific bucket. If you need to create a default SA we prefer you open a request and we create it for audit reasons.
jordan: tagging in — I can pre-approve a temporary SA creation for the sandbox project. @maria give alex.h 24h elevated access and we'll revoke after testing.
maria: done — added roles/browser and roles/iam.serviceAccountUser on redwood-eu-sandbox for 24h. You should be able to create and impersonate SAs now. Try `gcloud auth list` then `gcloud config set project redwood-eu-sandbox-2026`.
alex.h: tried those — `gcloud auth list` shows my account, switched project but was still hitting 403 on `gcloud iam service-accounts create test-sa`. Error: "PERMISSION_DENIED: The caller does not have permission to create service accounts."
tia: that means you need `roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin` or we can create the SA for you. If you're short-lived, reply with the SA name and permissions and we'll create it. Otherwise ask for the admin role.
alex.h: could you create `redwood-eu-sandbox-test-sa` with serviceAccountUser for my user and compute Admin for the project? I only need it for the container deploy.
jordan: done — SA created and bound to alex.h as serviceAccountUser. @samir once billing is linked please confirm and I'll drop the elevated roles.
samir: I've linked redwood-eu-sandbox-2026 to billing account 01A2-BC34-EE and set the cost center to "infra-eval-Q1". FYI we set a $300/month soft cap — ops will get an alert at 80%.
alex.h: confirmed — SA can be used now and my deploys work, thanks! One more q: any region-specific limits I should know about for europe-west1 GPUs?
maria: GPUs in eu regions are quota-limited. File the GPU quota request if you need >4 v100s. For short tests we can move you to preemptible VMs. Ping eng-infra for a fast quota bump if needed.
oncall-bot: Reminder — org policy requires MFA + hardware key for production billing operations. If you haven't completed 2FA, enable it at https://go/redwood/2fa.
alex.h: done, MFA enabled. thanks everyone for the quick help :raised_hands:
